About.Name: Jonah Byther
About.AboutText:
Hi, I am Jonah Byther. I am a passionate computer science student with a keen interest in software development and programming. Currently, I am pursuing my undergraduate degree at Seattle Pacific University. I am dedicated to expanding my knowledge and skills in various areas of computer science, with a particular focus on C++ programming.

I enjoy tackling challenging programming projects and I thrive in collaborative environments where I can contribute my expertise and learn from my peers. I love dealing with numbers and anything to do with them. I love watching and playing sports, especially football and soccer.

Experience.ExperienceText: I have held my position at Safeway for over 4 years now, and I do not plan on leaving until I get a full time job as a software engineer. I am an efficient worker and I am able to learn fast and learn anything put in front of me. If there is a challenge, I will tackle the challenge head on and I will make sure I figure it out. I am good at working with other people as well.
Experience.EducationText: I am currently going for my BS degree in computer science, and also minors in mathematics and data analytics.
Experience.EmploymentText: I go through the produce and throw away all the bad produce and put out the good produce.
Experience.SkillsText: I am a fast learner, have good people skills, and have great attention to detail.
